owner_authority.lifecycle_addendum_scope: C1 replaces prior tool-retention guidance: compare useful task scope and evidence; retire only when replacement coverage and comparative evidence support it; otherwise coexist or preserve uncertainty.

blueprint_source.admission_scope: H1 only: add a thin optional diagnostic over existing contracts when a local code-gap audit supports it. Do not add a universal handoff schema or claim empirical receiver compatibility.

local_gap_observation.existing_receiver_preflight: Checks caller-supplied source-receipt digest/projection, receiver capability declaration, workspace re-observation declaration, and observed artifact references.
local_gap_observation.existing_execution_effect_receipt: Checks caller-declared run/tool/version/source/input/output/environment and later observation; it is not bound to the Federation handoff action, approval decision, lease and receiver interface as one packet.
local_gap_observation.existing_producer_consumer_preflight: Checks bounded literal producer-consumer text semantics; it does not bind action authorization or receiver version.
local_gap_observation.narrow_delta: Verify that one exact pending action and its source revision, task-state revision, target artifact digest, approval record reference, packet digest, active lease, receiver ID/interface version, native-resume requirement, and external-session-reference kinds agree across existing caller-supplied records.

claim_ceiling: Pinned source and local-code gap mapping only. It does not demonstrate real-task benefit, authenticated authority, live state, accepted handoff, executable resume, or scientific validity.
